This site is designed to conform to the [Web Content Accessibility Guidelines
(WCAG) 2.1, Level AA](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG21/), the standard adopted by
the U.S. Department of Justice for state and local government web content under
Title II of the ADA (28 CFR Part 35).

**What that looks like here:**

-   Pages are semantic HTML with proper headings, landmarks, and labels, and
    work with keyboard navigation and screen readers.
-   Mathematics is rendered as MathML, so screen readers can read equations
    term by term rather than encountering an image.
-   Figures carry text descriptions, tables carry header markup, and color is
    never the only carrier of meaning. Text contrast meets or exceeds the
    4.5:1 minimum.
-   Pages reflow for small screens and zoom to 200% without horizontal
    scrolling; wide tables and equations scroll within their own frame and are
    keyboard-reachable.
-   Lecture slides are keyboard-navigable and their content is available to
    screen readers. Each deck is also available as a tagged PDF (one slide
    per page, validated against PDF/UA-2).
-   Every PDF on the site (worksheets, notes, slides, the syllabus) is
    tagged and validated against the PDF/UA-2 standard with veraPDF.

**If you hit a barrier** on this site or in any course material, please email
me at [dbhagia@fullerton.edu](mailto:dbhagia@fullerton.edu) and I will fix it
or provide the material in a form that works for you. For accommodations at
CSUF more broadly, contact [Disability Support
Services](https://www.fullerton.edu/dss/).

*Last reviewed: August 2026.*
